OBSERVATIONS AND CORRECTIVE ACTIONS
Item
Number		 Violations cited in this report must be corrected within the time frames below.
1 Violation of Code: [46.103] No food safety person present at arrival of the inspection.

Corrective action: The certified food safety person arrived prior to the completion of the inspection.

No person shall operate a food establishment that handles, prepares or serves non-prepackaged potentially hazardous food who does not have present and in the employ of the food establishment at all hours of operation at least one (1) person with a valid Food Establishment Personnel Food Safety Certificate issued by the Department. Corrected On-Site.
8 Violation of Code: [46.941(a)-(e)] Paper towel dispenser empty at the handwash sink in the front food prep area.

Corrective action: PIC provided paper towels during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site.
8 Violation of Code: [46.824(a)] The food facility does not have a handwash sink conveniently located in the warewashing area. New Violation.
14 Violation of Code: [46.712] Slicer has an accumulation of food residue on the food contact surfaces and is not being washed, rinsed and sanitized at least every 4 hours. New Violation.
22 Violation of Code: [46.385(c)] No time log observed for 6 pizzas being held at room temperature at the clerk counter.

Corrective action: PIC made a time log and presented it to the sanitarian during the time of inspection due to pizzas still being within the 4 hour window. Corrected On-Site.
26 Violation of Code: [46.1026] Observed insecticides not labeled by the manufacturer for food facility usage, in the food prep area on a shelf. New Violation.
34 Violation of Code: [46.561] Temperature measuring devices for ensuring proper temperatures of food are not available or readily accessible. New Violation.
35 Violation of Code: [46.282] Containers in the walk in cooler are not labeled with the name of its contents. Repeat Violation.
36 Violation of Code: [46.922(c)] An insect control device (UV insect light) located in the customer waiting area on top of beverages with potential to contaminate food, equipment, and / or utensils. New Violation.
36 Violation of Code: [46.981(k)(l)] Visible physical evidence of insect activity (House Flies) observed in the food prep areas. New Violation.
45 Violation of Code: [46.522] Soda crates being used for elevation and storage of beverages throughout the facility. New Violation.
49 Violation of Code: [46.822] No air gap observed at the food prep sink. New Violation.
51 Violation of Code: [46.981(b)(i)] Heavy static dust accumulation present on the fan cover in the restroom area. New Violation.

Summary
Statements 		This inspection has revealed that the establishment is not in satisfactory compliance. Corrective action is required to eliminate these violations. Compliance status will be assessed upon reinspection.
You are required under Section 6-502 of the Philadelphia Health Code to correct the violations listed as noted above. Your failure to correct these violations may result in the revocation of your health license and other legal action. Reinstatement of a revoked health license will require payment of another license fee. An appeal to these orders may be made to the Board of License and Inspection Review, Municipal Services Building, 1401 JFK Boulevard Philadelphia, PA 19102-1617
